frozen_predictor.causal_semantics: identical to experiments/R2-10-working-set-predictor/causal_boundary.json prediction_instant: prediction for the layer's NEXT same-layer event is made strictly after observing the current same-layer event and before the next one is observed

families.name: Predicted-Protect (hard shield)
families.exact_state: Identical to AgedFrequency(decay_factor, aging_interval_steps) state (resident bytes map, per-object score, per-object last_ref, global access ordinal t) PLUS one frozen DecayedTransitionPredictor instance and one growing same-layer history tuple per layer.
families.exact_eviction_rule: Victim = min over resident objects of (score, last_ref, stable_obj_key), restricted to objects of the SAME layer being served whose expert id is NOT in that layer's current predicted-next set; if the restricted candidate set is empty for that layer, fall back to the unrestricted AgedFrequency choice over all resident objects (total, deterministic, guarantees no deadlock).
families.exact_predictor_use: Causal protection signal only (membership test), never a continuous score; refreshed once per same-layer event, strictly after that event is served.
families.deterministic_tie_breaking: (score, last_ref, (layer, expert_id)) ascending, exactly AgedFrequency's own tie-break, both inside and outside the protected-restricted candidate pool.
families.memory_accounting: Reuses argine.research.policies.Context.bytes_of(layer) and the same resident_bytes <= budget invariant enforced every access() call by argine.research2.r2_09a.fast_replay.run_fast via InvariantViolation.
families.causal_boundary: Identical to R2-10's; see frozen_predictor.causal_semantics above. Predictor never receives same-layer future, same-step-later-layer, or future-step data.
families.candidate_hyperparameters: None beyond the already-frozen per-budget B_selected(M) base (decay_factor, aging_interval_steps) -- the smallest mechanism in this family: shield on, no tunable strength.
families.finite_grid: 1 config per budget (3 budgets x 1 config = 3 total cells for this family).

families.name: Predictor Retention Score (soft additive bonus)
families.exact_state: Identical to predicted_protect's state, plus one frozen scalar `bonus` per config.
families.exact_eviction_rule: Victim = min over resident objects of (score + bonus_if_predicted, last_ref, stable_obj_key). The bonus is added ONLY at comparison time, never persisted into self.scores, so it cannot leak into aging or hit-scoring arithmetic.
families.exact_predictor_use: Causal protection signal, applied as a fixed scalar nudge to the tie-break key rather than a hard restriction.
families.candidate_hyperparameters: bonus in the frozen grid {0.0, 1.0, 4.0}. bonus=0.0 is the mandatory control cell: it must reproduce AgedFrequency / B_selected(M) bit-for-bit (first-class correctness check, see leakage_contract.json and tests/test_r2_bridge01_control_equivalence.py).
families.finite_grid: 3 bonus values per budget (3 budgets x 3 bonus values = 9 total cells for this family).

total_grid_size.note: predicted_protect (3 cells, one per budget) + predictor_retention_score (9 cells, 3 bonus values x 3 budgets) = 12 mechanism-config cells. Intentionally small: no large policy tournament, per the Phase-0 handoff instruction.

no_prefetching: This bridge does not add prefetching. Only resident-set retention/eviction decisions are affected; no additional I/O or timing semantics are introduced. Prefetch is explicitly out of scope and kept separable for any future protocol.
baseline_reuse: Both families wrap, never replace, the already-frozen B_selected(M) implementation (argine.research2.r2_09a.policies.AgedFrequency) at each budget's frozen hyperparameters -- see contract.json.baseline_binding.
